Details: A zombie outbreak begins from a selected profile and spreads through vulnerable regions.
Type Options: Diverse, Random, Standard, Rabid, Parasitic, Mutant, Undead, Necrotic, Demonic, Connected
Intensity Scaling: Low, Medium, High, and Maximum increase outbreak count, starting territory, spawned divisions, and early pressure.

Details: An artificial army appears across Eastern Europe and the western Soviet borderlands.
Type Options: Standard clone army or stronger Aryan variant
Intensity Scaling: Low, Medium, High, and Maximum scale territory, divisions, army experience, equipment stockpiles, and pressure on neighboring countries.

Details: The Soviet Union breaks apart as the Union Unmade crisis releases its republics.
Intensity Scaling: Low, Medium, High, and Maximum add scaled breakaway armies, manpower, infantry equipment, support equipment, artillery, and motorized equipment.

Details: The Holy Realm begins its Final Silence from the player's country.
Intensity Scaling: Fixed intensity follows the canonical four-wave Final Silence sequence.

Details: Fury actors appear as a dispersed AI war and begin their expansion.
Type Options: Pact forms The Fury Pact among Fury actors. Hostile mode sends Fury actors into wars with neighbors and rival Fury actors.
Intensity Scaling: Low, Medium, High, and Maximum target 2, 5, 9, and 16 Fury actors, limited by safe eligible countries. Maximum records the full-spread challenge when every safe candidate or the maximum roster is used.

Details: Death begins with a hidden origin, extra islands, and a mainland reveal before natural growth carries the crisis further.
Intensity Scaling: Low starts with one hidden island, one mainland reveal state, and one weak passive host. Medium adds a small island pattern, one mainland reveal state, extra mainland pressure, and two weak passive hosts. High widens the island pattern, adds mainland pressure around the world, and brings two stronger hosts. Maximum opens the widest instant island pattern, multiple mainland pressure points, and four stronger hosts.

Details: A selected country enters a season of varied disasters, with warnings, damage, recovery, and follow-up risks.
Type Options: Random Barrage, Geological Crisis, Weather Crisis, Skyfall Crisis, Full Catalogue
Intensity Scaling: Low intensity starts a varied local season with ordinary warnings, affected-country reports, and recovery work. Medium intensity lengthens the sequence and opens regional damage with heavier recovery pressure. High intensity creates severe chained disasters with catastrophic impacts and emergency aftermath work. Maximum intensity can unleash rupture waves, meteor showers, massive eruptions, delayed tsunami chains, and moving storm corridors before the rescue and reconstruction struggle.

Details: Every researched independence movement with a safe homeland is considered before the incident begins. Each former host keeps one protected state, and no two banners can claim the same anchor. Valid countries emerge together as sovereign states outside any faction. Intensity changes territory, forces, institutions, and diplomatic pressure without removing any viable movement from consideration.
Type Options: Sovereign Scatter, Common Congress, Wars of Separation, Universal Belligerence: Former Hosts, Universal Belligerence: Neighboring Releases, Universal Belligerence: Nearby Nonleague States, Patron Worlds, Great Partition
Intensity Scaling:
Low: All viable candidates are still attempted. Each valid release receives only its anchor, fragile local defense, scarce stocks, weak institutions, low recognition, and severe opening instability.

Medium: All viable candidates are still attempted. Valid releases receive compact territory, viable militia and border formations, baseline institutions, and ordinary route access.

High: All viable candidates are still attempted. Valid releases receive extended territory where collisions permit, armed forces, stronger depots and officers, firmer institutions, faster league development, and accelerated ambitions.

Maximum: All viable candidates are still attempted. Valid releases receive the strongest non-overlapping territory and forces, rare support where their researched route permits it, high-chaos access, early formable discovery, and aggressive AI pressure.

Details:
Discipline Collapse: A wartime supply crisis has broken discipline inside selected formations. Field Hunger rises while damaged commands attempt containment before predation spreads beyond the first theaters.

Ritual Cells: Officer circles and hidden field kitchens have become organized ritual cells. Cult Cohesion is already visible, and several countries may begin with compromised commands.

Silent Islands: Remote ports and island garrisons have fallen quiet behind broken convoy schedules. Communes begin with mature cells, exposed sea routes, and a growing risk of armed island hosts.

Warlord States: Armed host countries emerge from occupied feeding grounds. Each begins with a regional command, an origin doctrine, scavenged stores, and forces raised from the territory it has seized.

Convergence: Several mature host countries answer a common signal. A public convergence warning begins after launch, leaving the world time to destroy the likely hosts and sever their routes before a final authority emerges.
Type Options: Discipline Collapse, Ritual Cells, Silent Islands, Warlord States, Convergence
Intensity Scaling: Low intensity starts a narrow crisis with limited territory and forces. Containment remains possible while delay strengthens the cells. Medium intensity brings several formations or theaters into the crisis, with supply pressure, concealment, and foreign routes demanding an organized response. High intensity starts mature cells and armed hosts with strong cohesion, severe command damage, and multiple routes across the map. Maximum intensity builds a broad international network with numerous theaters and host countries, making escalation immediate while its supply lines, leaders, territories, and convergence routes remain vulnerable.

Details: A valid AI coalition forms from the full eligible pool and reveals itself against the selected human target.
Type Options: Regional Ring, Ideological Front, Great-Power Sponsor, Unlikely Coalition, Random Coalition
Intensity Scaling: Low intensity forms a compact coalition of three governments with limited stockpiles. A great-power-backed coalition has one major sponsor and two minor partners, while other coalitions draw from three minor governments. Medium intensity brings five governments with liaison and logistics, with one major sponsor in great-power mode and five minor governments otherwise. High intensity brings one major and six minor governments with coordinated logistics and advanced preparations. Maximum intensity can bring up to twelve safe governments and two eligible majors, with full war pressure and challenge eligibility when the requested roster or the safe pool is exhausted.

Details: The Unbidden Muster begins at once with connected revolt regions, new formations, and wars against former parents. Ordinary, armored, amphibious, and nonhuman hosts compete for supply routes and command.
Type Options: The Barracks Overflow, The Arsenal Draw, The Generals' Muster, The Impossible Host
Intensity Scaling: Low intensity starts immediate revolts and regional wars in a smaller share of countries and establishes one principal front per selected command area. Medium intensity spreads several formation lots across broad command areas and establishes full-strength local fronts. High intensity affects many countries at once, establishes larger formation pools, and can open several rival fronts. Maximum intensity reaches every country able to sustain an open front and creates the largest sustainable formation packages and front count.

Details: Black Plague erupts across several continents, activates Evolutions I through IV, seeds brood basins in RTA, and creates the separate RTX Rat King. Evolution V and world end remain locked until the earned terminal route.
Intensity Scaling: Low intensity seeds three eligible continents with a limited crisis, 14 established states, 2 internal RTA brood basins, and 1 separate RTX Royal Basin state. Evolutions I through IV activate, while Evolution V and world end remain locked. Chaos floor 400. Medium intensity seeds four eligible continents with a regional crisis, 28 established states, 3 internal RTA brood basins, and 2 separate RTX Royal Basin states. Evolutions I through IV activate, while Evolution V and world end remain locked. Chaos floor 600. High intensity seeds five eligible continents, or all available continents, with 52 established states, 4 internal RTA brood basins, and 4 separate RTX Royal Basin states. Evolutions I through IV activate, while Evolution V and world end remain locked. Chaos floor 800. Maximum intensity seeds every eligible inhabited continent with 90 established states, 6 internal RTA brood basins, and 8 separate RTX Royal Basin states. Only RTA and RTX are created, and Evolution V and world end remain locked. Chaos floor 999.
